tools.name: stores-search
tools.description: Search for physical stores in Spain near a location (lat/lon, or a place name). Returns up to 20 stores with name, address, city, coordinates, distance, and opening hours. Many small shops have no street address: use city and coordinates.

tools.name: products-search-nearby
tools.description: Search for products available in nearby physical stores in Spain. Pass lat/lon, or a place name if you do not have coordinates. Returns stores ordered by usefulness (priced and in stock first), each with up to 3 matching products: price, availability, trust level, and distance. Queries work best in

tools.name: stores-get
tools.description: Get details of a specific store and part of its inventory. A supermarket can carry thousands of products, so pass query to search inside the store (e.g. "leche"); without it you get the 50 most recently updated. limit goes up to 100. inventory_total says how many products the store has in all.

tools.name: products-get
tools.description: Get details of a specific product and the stores that carry it. Pass lat and lon to get the 10 nearest stores (recommended); without them you get 10 stores in no particular order. stores_total says how many carry it in all.
